reading.zh: 从左到右：init 建运行时，ingest 收帧，frame-cache 存帧，semantic-request 发起语义请求，semantic-commit 提交结果，status 汇报状态，stop-mask 标记停机；箭头是一帧从入库到结果回写的全流程。
reading.en: Left to right: init builds the runtime, ingest receives frames, frame-cache holds them, semantic-request asks the model, semantic-commit writes the answer back, status reports and stop-mask marks shutdown; arrows trace one frame from ingest to the committed result.
